Stacked on #217 (`t3/analysis-sequence`). This is the last part (8) of the bank sync and organizer redesign. It adds the owner-facing surfaces and the README note.

## What changes

- **Money → AI organizer** (`/money/organize`): one place for every AI decision, as agreed in the design. It has three tabs.
  - **Needs you:** open questions, grouped by payee with their rows.
    - Picking a category (and an optional merchant) calls `confirm_organize_memory`. Every blank or AI-labelled row of that payee is labelled in one undoable batch, and the question closes.
    - "Recently answered" has an Undo.
    - A question can also be dismissed.
  - **AI decided:** every row labelled by the AI, a rule, memory or the bank's data, with its source, confidence and reason.
    - It can be filtered by source.
    - Each row can be undone, and "Undo all" takes back a whole pass.
    - **Looks right** (new `confirm_ai_organization`) turns the label into the owner's, so calibration counts it as correct.
  - **Memory:** what Moneo remembers per payee and the rows each entry covers.
    - Entries can be edited or removed (new `remove_organize_memory`); labels already written keep their own undo.
    - Categories and merchants the AI created are listed here too.
- **Chat and voice:**
  - `organize_review` reads questions, decisions or memory.
  - `organize_propose` makes a new `organize_answer` card. Accepting it runs the same audited calls as the page, so writes from chat stay cards.
  - The system prompt and the voice step labels are updated.
- **Home:** one status line, shown only when there is something to say:
  - "N rows need you";
  - a pass that is waiting, or one that will run again after the current one;
  - a plan-limit pause until it resets.
- **Command palette:** gets the page through the shared nav list.
- **Reset:** the new tables cascade from the workspace. `reset-workspace.sql` already seeds and checks them.
- **README:** a short paragraph on how new transactions are organized and where to review them.
- **Migration:** `202611140001_organize_surfaces.sql`.

## Before / after

Screenshots were taken from the QA server with synthetic data. They aren't committed, and are shared in the conversation.

- **Before:**
  - AI decisions could only be seen per agent run on the Agents page, with a single Undo there.
  - Low-confidence labels piled up as one card per description.
  - Nothing showed what Moneo remembered.
- **After:**
  - **Needs you** shows "J. Meyer — 3 rows: what are they for?" and "PayPal — 2 rows". One answer labels all of a payee's rows.
  - **AI decided** lists each label with its source ("AI · high confidence", "Your rule", "Your confirmed payee", "Bank data"), its reason, Looks right and Undo, plus "Undo all" per pass.
  - Mobile and dark layouts were checked for all three tabs and for the Home line.

## Checks

- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` and `npm run check:bundle`: pass. The new page is 163 KB.
- `npm test`: 1658 passed, 10 skipped.
- New browser journey `e2e/organize.gated.spec.ts`: passes on two runs. It seeds a question and an AI label, answers the question, checks that the rows got labels, then undoes the AI label from AI decided.
- SQL regressions `organize-surfaces`, `organize-identity`, `organize-provenance` and `reset-workspace`: pass against QA.
- `npm run test:db`: stops at the known fresh-vs-upgraded drift. The shared QA stack has migrations from other branches.

## Limits

- Questions without a resolvable payee link to Transactions instead of showing the answer form.
- Chat cards accept only existing categories and merchants.
- An answer from a chat card without an open question can only be undone from the transactions themselves.

content.text:
The redesign is finished as 8 stacked PRs, each with before/after evidence in its description. None are merged. Merge them in order from #204, and before merging each one, change the next PR's base to `main`.

| # | PR | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [#204](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/204) | Retries the gateway's 502s, reports a failed run as failed, one agent run at a time, and runs the categorizer before the other agents |
| 2 | [#205](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/205) | Stops two syncs of the same bank running at once, retries a failed first sync, and makes a limited account wait only as long as the bank asks |
| 3 | [#207](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/207) | Marks every AI label as AI (never as yours), makes it undoable, and auto-applies only high and medium confidence |
| 4 | [#209](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/209) | Keeps everything the bank sends for each transaction (merchant code, codes, creditor ID, counterparty) |
| 5 | [#213](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/213) | Fixed rules for own transfers and currency exchanges, recognising the same payee across spellings, and merchant memory |
| 6 | [#216](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/216) | New organizer: the bank's data first, then an AI that must answer every row. On the synthetic test it labels 91% of rows instead of 65%, and leaves none blank instead of 35% |
| 7 | [#217](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/217) | One delayed pass per workspace instead of one per sync; banks sync together. In a simulated day: 2 agent runs instead of 4, and 0 rows left uncategorized instead of 70 |
| 8 | [#218](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/218) | The **AI organizer** page (Needs you / AI decided / Memory), a Home status line, chat tools, a browser test and the README note |

**What wasn't run or isn't finished:**
- **Database tests:** on every branch, `npm run test:db` stops at the fresh-vs-upgraded comparison. The shared test database has migrations from other branches, so the two don't match. For #218 nothing else in that suite ran; its four new database tests pass when run alone.
- **Old test failures:** four live database tests (row-undo, evidence-receipts, reservation-balance, review-reservation) fail on every branch and also fail on `main`.
- **Evidence:** the organizer numbers come from a synthetic test set and a mocked AI, not from your real data.
- **Answering from chat:** the chat card can only pick existing categories and merchants. An answer from chat that has no open question can only be undone from the transactions themselves.
- **Privacy:** person names inside the free-text description are still sent to the AI; only the payee name is hidden.

The screenshots aren't in the PR descriptions, because the GitHub CLI can't attach images; the #218 description says they were shared here instead. These two are from the test server with made-up data:

![Needs you](C:\Users\mgsuk\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\87163e3c6fbbc53e\2ef1e7b1-64cd-4581-b5fd-c475fd596755\scratchpad\shots\after-organize-needs.png)
![AI decided, mobile dark](C:\Users\mgsuk\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\87163e3c6fbbc53e\2ef1e7b1-64cd-4581-b5fd-c475fd596755\scratchpad\shots\after-organize-decided-mobile-dark.png)

The rest (the Agents page before, Memory, Home, dark and mobile) are in `C:\Users\mgsuk\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\87163e3c6fbbc53e\2ef1e7b1-64cd-4581-b5fd-c475fd596755\scratchpad\shots\`. You'd need to drag them into the #218 description yourself.
